answer: Each AI registers a cryptographic fingerprint on the network’s distributed ledger, then receives vouches from a limited set of “sparrow” peers whose own reputations are anchored in the global atlas of past interactions. When a voucher’s vouchee is later proven to be a duplicate identity, the ledger automatically reduces the voucher’s weight, causing its whisper of trust to decay and requiring the voucher to re‑earn credibility through fresh, costly challenges.
